## Highlights

- A source invoice whose subtotal leaves out GST-free lines no longer holds a right invoice for review when its total and GST match. ([#495](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/495))
- Home shows stat cards, and an invoice problem has a Copy prompt button to hand it to an assistant. ([#495](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/495))
